in_marathi.name: Dhanapati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanapati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanapati is a Sanskrit name derived from the two words ‘Dhan’ meaning wealth and ‘Pati’ meaning master or lord. The name is associated with the Hindu deity Ganesha, who is believed to be the lord of wealth and prosperity. This name is given to boys to bless them with abundance, wealth, and success in their lives.
